name: Entity Hierarchy Group Support
description: Group module support for Entity Hierarchy.
project_description:
Add Group support for Entity Reference Hierarchy.

 Features 
 Adds support for group module to Entity Reference Hierarchy.

- Adds option to restrict the selection of parent entities to the current group context.

- Adds option to restrict selection of parent entities outside of group context if not in group context.

- Adds option to only allow one similar hierarchy for each group.

 Post-Installation 
 Adjust Entity hierarchy group settings. 

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires Group 3.x and Entity Reference Hierarchy 5.x
